name: whats-new
description: Checks whether a newer Campus AI OS is available and what changed. Compares the installed version against the public release list on GitHub and says where to get the update. Use when the owner says "/whats-new", "is there an update", "am I on the latest version", "what's new in the OS", or when another skill notices the campus may be behind. Read-only: never downloads, never installs, never sends anything about the campus.
